$comment: Registry of MCP servers this host can front. Add entries with `npm run probe -- <url> --save`. See ../.claude/skills/mcp-app-onboarding.

servers.label: Viator Experiences
servers.notes: Tours and activities. No auth. Ships an MCP App (SEP-1865).

servers.label: Peloton Classes
servers.notes: Class search. Only `search` is noauth; the rest need member OAuth.

servers.label: Adobe Creativity
servers.notes: Adobe creative apps. Every call, tools/list included, needs an Adobe ID login via IMS (dynamic registration). IMS only accepts loopback or allowlisted redirect URIs, so Connect works from a local run but not from the Vercel deployment. IMS requires openid and rejects the advertised llm.assets.* scopes for a dynamically registered client, hence the explicit list.

servers.label: DeepWiki (data only)
servers.notes: Documentation Q&A for GitHub repositories. Data only — no UI resources, so nothing to render.
